<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> (formerly known as <b>Red fish fillets</b>) are a [[cooking]] resource used in various [[Fishing|fish]]-related recipes. It can either be crafted at the cooking table or purchased from the [[Lighthouse Keeper]]. The [[Bishop]] will request 4x {{Quality|Copper}} for a quest, and the [[Gypsy Baron]] will request 4x {{Quality|Silver}} for a side-quest.

As of the official release of the game, the gold-quality quality-fish-fillets are not available, as none of the fish that provide these fillets will ever spawn with a gold-quality.
